matches.rationale: The ground truth concerns an incorrect assumption that the shortest-path-tree topology is public and misapplication of Lemma 2.4 in Sections 3 and 4. None of the findings address this public-topology assumption or Lemma 2.4; they instead focus on unrelated technical issues (error scaling factors, cluster-membership logic, base-case handling, Binomial distribution misuse, and a missing square root in composition), so none detect this defect.

pred_verdicts.rationale: Identifies a plausible missing factor of log n in the error bound of Eq. (3), a distinct issue not matching the GT's public-topology defect.
Flags a gap in the cluster-membership argument of Theorem 4.3, an issue unrelated to the GT's assumption about public tree topology.
Points out an unhandled base case (i=0) in the swapping procedure, a different and specific technical gap not covered by the GT item.
Correctly notes the Binomial distribution claim is inaccurate due to sampling without replacement, a separate issue from the GT's topology assumption.
Identifies a likely missing square root in the composition privacy parameter, unrelated to the GT's public-topology defect.
